cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(openvpn3_android LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# 16 KB page size extra linker flags (required for Android 16k page size)
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS
        "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} -Wl,-z,max-page-size=0x4000 -Wl,-z,common-page-size=0x4000"
)

# OpenVPN3 source root
set(O3_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/openvpn3")
set(DATAGATE_PATCH_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/patches")

# SWIG generated sources (generated by generate_swig.sh)
set(SWIG_WRAP_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/out/swig")
set(SWIG_WRAP_SRC "${SWIG_WRAP_DIR}/ovpncli_wrap.cxx")

# ====== CUSTOM DEPENDENCY SETTINGS ======
set(OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR "$ENV{HOME}/Android/deps/${ANDROID_ABI}/openssl")
set(OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR "${OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}/include")
set(OPENSSL_SSL_LIBRARY "${OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}/lib/libssl.a")
set(OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY "${OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}/lib/libcrypto.a")

set(LZ4_ROOT "$ENV{HOME}/Android/deps/${ANDROID_ABI}/lz4")
set(LZ4_INCLUDE_DIR "${LZ4_ROOT}/include")
set(LZ4_LIBRARY "${LZ4_ROOT}/lib/liblz4.a")

set(FMT_INCLUDE_DIR "${O3_DIR}/external/fmt/include")
set(ASIO_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/asio/asio/include")

# Override upstream openvpn/common/version.hpp default (IV_VER sent to server).
# Keep in sync with app/build.gradle.kts versionName.
set(DATAGATE_OPENVPN_VERSION "3.12_datagate_android_1.0.13" CACHE STRING "OpenVPN IV_VER string")
# =========================================

# Collect core sources (client + core), then exclude platform-specific agents
file(GLOB_RECURSE OPENVPN3_CORE_SOURCES
        "${O3_DIR}/client/*.cpp"
        "${O3_DIR}/openvpn/*.cpp"
)

# Exclude Windows/mac agents and OMI (desktop-only code)
list(FILTER OPENVPN3_CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/openvpn/ovpnagent/.*")
list(FILTER OPENVPN3_CORE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX ".*/openvpn/omi/.*")

add_library(ovpn3-core STATIC
        ${OPENVPN3_CORE_SOURCES}
)

# Build static core library as PIC so it can be linked into a shared JNI library
set_target_properties(ovpn3-core PROPERTIES
        POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
)

target_include_directories(ovpn3-core BEFORE PUBLIC
        ${DATAGATE_PATCH_INCLUDE_DIR}
        ${O3_DIR}
        ${O3_DIR}/client
        ${FMT_INCLUDE_DIR}
        ${ASIO_INCLUDE_DIR}
        ${OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR}
        ${LZ4_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

target_compile_definitions(ovpn3-core PRIVATE
        FMT_HEADER_ONLY
        ASIO_STANDALONE
        USE_ASIO
        HAVE_LZ4
        USE_OPENSSL
        "OPENVPN_VERSION=\"${DATAGATE_OPENVPN_VERSION}\""
)

# JNI shared library loaded from Java/Kotlin (wraps ovpn3-core)
add_library(ovpncli SHARED
        ${SWIG_WRAP_SRC}
        datagate_android_jni.cpp
)

target_include_directories(ovpncli PRIVATE
        ${O3_DIR}
        ${O3_DIR}/client
        ${FMT_INCLUDE_DIR}
        ${ASIO_INCLUDE_DIR}
        ${SWIG_WRAP_DIR}
        ${OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR}
        ${LZ4_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

target_compile_definitions(ovpncli PRIVATE
        FMT_HEADER_ONLY
        ASIO_STANDALONE
        USE_ASIO
        HAVE_LZ4
        USE_OPENSSL
)

target_link_libraries(ovpncli
        ovpn3-core
        ${OPENSSL_SSL_LIBRARY}
        ${OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY}
        ${LZ4_LIBRARY}
)

# Do not garbage-collect sections in JNI lib, otherwise JNI methods may be dropped
target_link_options(ovpncli PRIVATE
        "-Wl,--no-gc-sections"
)

# Output directory for .so files (per ABI)
set_target_properties(ovpncli PROPERTIES
        LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/out/${ANDROID_ABI}"
)
